name: Pidilite Industries Ltd
title: Pidilite Industries Ltd - 500331 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone UVG 15.3% and EBITDA margin 23.4% (+280bps), but management is passing through 40–50% raw material inflation with VAM-driven price hikes of ~12–15% on Fevicol and no FY27 volume guidance.

capex.quote: we would have spent close to INR 570 crores on capex compared to INR 430 crores in the prior year

triggers.label: Price hikes ~4–5% Apr + 7–8% May
triggers.quote: at company level, we have taken in April around 4% to 5%. And in early May, another 7% to 8%

triggers.label: No FY27 UVG guidance; full-year volume not assumed same
triggers.quote: So to be fair to say that the full year, should you assume that it will be the same? My answer is no.

triggers.label: Q4 UVG 15.3% vs 9.8% in 9M
triggers.quote: underlying volume growth of 15.3%. This compares to underlying volume growth of 9.8% that we had delivered till December

triggers.label: Capex ₹570 cr vs ₹430 cr; 3–5% of revenue band
triggers.quote: we would have spent close to INR 570 crores on capex compared to INR 430 crores in the prior year

triggers.label: No March loading; VAM covers above normal
triggers.quote: we have continued with our philosophy of not loading in any form in the month of March

guidance.quote: we have guided a corridor of 20% to 24%. We stay committed to that guidance.
suffice to say the band is 3% to 5%. And I think we'll remain in that band.

guidance.value: about 100 bps higher than FY26 (~11.1%) planned
guidance.quote: this about 100-odd bps expansion as we go forward is something we are planning for and we would like to deliver.

prior_guidance_check.quote: last year, of course, with benign input costs, we delivered at the higher end of the guidance

red_flags.label: FY27 demand compression risk flagged by management
red_flags.quote: if you were to look at FY '27, with the kind of inflation across categories, across businesses, there will be some demand compression.

red_flags.label: Price hikes not guaranteed to be held if RM cools
red_flags.quote: If it indeed cools off quickly, it will have to be passed back in some form.

evasions.quote: So I don't think we will hazard a guess as to what will be the UVG for this year.
This I leave to you. I will not be able to give you your formula for the thing.
can you build in that for the year? The answer at this moment is no.
